en.title: Find Valid IP Addresses
en.description:
Recursively scan the whitespace-separated tokens in files under root, collect valid IPv4 addresses, and sort them lexicographically, keeping duplicates.

The standard input/output format and supplementary bounds on this site are as stated in this problem.
en.input: The first line is the root path; the second line is the number of files f (≤2×10^5); each following line is `path<TAB>content`, where path is an absolute POSIX path, file contents contain no tabs, and the total number of characters is ≤10^6.
en.output: One address per line; if there are no results, output nothing.
en.explanation: Use `commonpath` to determine strict descendants of the path; check each token for 4 decimal octet fields; keep duplicate tokens and then sort. Time is O(input length + sorting the results).
